title: Transition Bounds and a Two-Pulse Criterion in a Six-Spin Exchange Model
content: We consider a six-spin Heisenberg exchange model with a common nonnegative coupling for three matched intergroup pairs and another for six unmatched pairs. For a specified initial spin sector and final projective measurement, we obtain an operator identity showing that the transition probability is independent of the state within the input sector. Its maximum is 4/9 for constant couplings and 1/2 for switched couplings. For two prescribed nonzero Hamiltonians with nonnegative coupling parameters, we give a necessary and sufficient polynomial inequality for attaining 1/2, together with positive attaining durations. A strictly positive coupling family has an exact two-interval threshold. We also exhibit two control pairs with the same nonzero commutator but different two-interval maxima. The results follow from an exact invariant-subspace reduction and two-level unitary dynamics; finite-matrix checks supplement the proofs.
